movie.title: Husbands in Action

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A hot-headed narcotics detective and his ex-wife's mild-mannered new husband are forced into a chaotic alliance when the woman they both love is kidnapped by a criminal organization.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: When his ex-wife Si-nae and their daughter are abducted by a ruthless drug kingpin's faction, veteran narcotics inspector Hwang Choong-sik must initiate an off-the-books rescue mission. To save them, he is reluctantly forced to partner with Lee Min-seok, Si-nae's sensible new husband and a practicing veterinarian. Clashing over everything from parenting styles to tactical decisions, the two men must survive dangerous underworld enforcers and internal rivalries. Ultimately, the unlikely duo must put aside their fierce jealousy and personal differences to execute a wild, high-stakes rescue.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Narcotics inspector Hwang Choong-sik is a veteran detective whose aggressive tactics often get him into trouble, but nothing prepares him for meeting Lee Min-seok, his ex-wife Si-nae's new husband. Their immediate power struggle over their roles in Si-nae and young daughter Yeon-ju's lives creates a fierce personal rivalry. However, petty domestic friction is cut short when Si-nae and Yeon-ju are suddenly kidnapped as leverage in a dangerous scheme involving drug lord Ma Do-jun and his calculating wife Hye-ran. Determined to bring their family back safely, Choong-sik and Min-seok form an uneasy pact to track down the abductors on their own. Throughout their desperate search, the two men constantly clash due to Choong-sik's reckless impulse and Min-seok's methodical, mild-mannered nature. Matters grow increasingly volatile as disgraced mobsters and inquisitive journalists enter the fray, raising the stakes at every turn. Navigating car chases, brutal turf wars, and high-octane standoffs, the ex-husband and current husband learn to leverage each other's unique strengths. In a chaotic climax, they must coordinate seamlessly to outsmart the masterminds and bring their shared loved ones home.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Hwang Choong-sik, a tough narcotics detective, finds his life turned upside down when he crosses paths with Lee Min-seok, a mild-mannered veterinarian who recently married Choong-sik's ex-wife, Si-nae. Their awkward meeting quickly devolves into an intense, hilarious rivalry over who holds the real patriarchal authority in the family. But when Si-nae and her daughter are unexpectedly abducted by ruthless figures from the criminal underworld, the feud is abruptly sidelined. Realizing that standard police procedures won't move fast enough, Choong-sik and Min-seok decide to take matters into their own hands, initiating a wild rescue operation. Along the way, the opposites-attract pair must navigate dangerous underworld encounters, eccentric criminals, and unpredictable setbacks, all while trying not to drive each other crazy. Equal parts action-packed thrill ride and hilarious buddy comedy, 'Husbands in Action' explores how far two wildly different men will go to protect the family they love.

story_structure.climax: They locate the kidnappers' hideout and launch a high-octane rescue operation, facing off against the main captors in a final, tense confrontation.
story_structure.conflict: The two fiercely contrasting men must agree to work together despite their personal resentment and competing egos to track down her location.
story_structure.resolution: With the rescue attempt concluded, the two men establish a mutual, if grudging, respect for one another as they deal with the aftermath of their wild mission.
story_structure.introduction: A detective is forced to cross paths with his ex-wife's new husband when she is suddenly kidnapped by a criminal group.
story_structure.risingAction: As the duo pursues leads through dangerous encounters and high-stakes situations, their conflicting personalities trigger ongoing friction while they gradually learn to leverage each other's strengths.
